purpose: Read the flagged C14 tree roads against the nearby emitted model beads.
rounded_bead_model: Each bead has a horizontal flat core of width minus height, swept along its road, rounded by a sphere of radius half the bead height. The commanded nozzle Z and feature-specific layer height set its vertical position.
scope: Checks the flagged roads against nearby emitted model roads; physical ooze, shrinkage and removal force are unmeasured.
